blocks.text: Cloud computing provides the infrastructure to host websites and deliver content worldwide. AWS and Microsoft Azure host businesses' websites on cloud servers, and content delivery networks (CDNs) such as Cloudflare deliver content quickly by caching it on servers close to users.

blocks.prompt: Why does a CDN make a website load faster?
blocks.explanation: It keeps copies of the content on servers near each user, so data travel a shorter distance.

items: Web hosting on cloud servers; CDNs cache content near users (Cloudflare).
